name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
summary: An urban housing mission that provides central assistance and interest subsidy to economically weaker sections and lower income groups to enable them to build or buy a pucca house.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant's annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3 lakh.
The applicant must not already own a pucca house.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible beneficiary receives central assistance of about Rs. 2.67 lakh towards the house.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the urban local body.

appeal_hierarchy.authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
